execution_policy: Future implementation step only; tests must use temporary directories and synthetic identities, no model/Agent/RAG/HTTP and no real lifecycle ledger mutation.

tests.name: retired_r8_authorization_cannot_be_reused

tests.name: r8_authorization_cannot_authorize_r9

tests.name: r9_freeze_creation_grants_no_execution_permission

tests.name: fresh_r9_authorization_rejected_while_old_executable_auth_active

tests.name: historical_ledger_truncation_detected
tests.expected: FAIL_CLOSED current length below pinned prefix length

tests.name: duplicate_retirement_rejected

tests.name: concurrent_retirement_serialized
tests.expected: One append succeeds; competing append sees terminal event and fails under shared lock

tests.name: crash_during_retirement_recoverable_without_retry

tests.name: namespace_authority_unchanged

tests.name: canonical_freeze_source_shared_by_formal_entry_and_adapter

tests.name: malformed_appended_lifecycle_event_rejected
